mg-mg3.note: Petrol (manual) and Hybrid+ are both front-wheel drive

mg-zs.note: 1.5 petrol and Hybrid+ are both front-wheel drive

mg-mg4.note: Single-motor versions are RWD; AWD only on the dual-motor MG4 XPOWER (320 kW), still offered for MY26

mg-mg4-urban.note: Front motor, FWD only (43 and 54 kWh)

mg-hs.note: 1.5T petrol, Hybrid+ and PHEV are all front-wheel drive; no AWD in Europe

mg-im5.note: RWD single motor 300 kW (CH: 100 Long Range, DE: 100 kWh Premium); AWD dual motor 553 kW (CH: 100 Performance, DE: 100 kWh Premium AWD)

mg-im6.note: RWD single motor 300 kW (CH: 100 Long Range, DE: 100 kWh Premium); AWD dual motor 553 kW (CH: 100 Performance, DE: 100 kWh Premium AWD)

mg-mgs6-ev.note: RWD single motor; AWD dual motor (DE: Luxury AWD, UK: Trophy Dual Motor 266 kW) with the 77 kWh battery only

mg-mgs9-phev.note: 1.5T plug-in hybrid (HS PHEV drivetrain), front-wheel drive only

mg-cyberster.note: Base Cyberster (Trophy) single motor 250 kW RWD; Cyberster XPOWER (formerly GT) dual motor 375 kW AWD

maxus-mifa-7.note: Single 180 kW front motor, FWD only

maxus-mifa-9.note: Single 180 kW front motor (same drive unit as Mifa 7), FWD only

maxus-edeliver-5-van-mid.note: Assumed front-motor FWD like the other Maxus electric vans; no AWD version known

maxus-edeliver-9.note: eDeliver 9 (BEV) is FWD; diesel Deliver 9 is offered with FWD or RWD (RWD on heavier vans and chassis cabs)

maxus-t60-max.note: Sold in Europe as 2.0 diesel double cab with selectable 4WD and low range; no 2WD version seen

maxus-t90-ev.note: Single rear motor, RWD only; run-out

ford-explorer.note: RWD single motor; AWD dual motor (250 kW) only with the Extended Range battery

ford-kuga.note: AWD only with the 2.5 Full Hybrid (FHEV); 1.5 EcoBoost and PHEV are FWD

ford-mustang-mach-e.note: RWD single motor (Standard/Extended Range); AWD dual motor on Extended Range AWD, GT and Rally

ford-bronco.note: 4x4 only (2.7 EcoBoost V6, Badlands and Outer Banks); not officially sold in Switzerland

ford-mustang.note: RWD only (5.0 V8 GT, Dark Horse, GTD)

ford-tourneo-courier.note: Petrol and E-Tourneo Courier are both FWD

ford-transit-connect.note: AWD only with the 2.0 EcoBlue diesel; PHEV is FWD

ford-transit-courier.note: Petrol, diesel and E-Transit Courier are all FWD

ford-transit-city.note: Single-motor electric van; FWD assumed, drive layout not confirmed; no AWD

ford-transit.note: Diesel offered with FWD, RWD or AWD; E-Transit is RWD

ford-ranger.note: 4x4 only in Europe, incl. Raptor and PHEV (part-time or permanent 4WD); no 4x2 seen

subaru-solterra.note: Dual-motor AWD only (252 kW / 343 PS, 73.1 kWh); no FWD in CH or DE

dr-dr-1-0-ev.note: Chery-based city EV, believed rear motor and RWD; not confirmed; no AWD

dr-dr-5.note: Petrol, LPG and HEV, FWD only

dr-dr-6.note: Petrol, LPG and PHEV, FWD only

ebro-s700.note: 1.6 TGDI petrol, HEV and PHEV, all FWD

ebro-s800.note: 1.6 TGDI petrol and PHEV, both FWD

ebro-s900.note: PHEV assumed FWD; the related Jaecoo 8 is sold as AWD in Europe, so an AWD s900 cannot be ruled out

pagani-utopia.note: Mid-engined AMG V12, RWD (coupé and Roadster); run-out
